estimator.name: MediaPipe Pose GHUM 3D
estimator.timestamp_basis: source frame index divided by reported constant FPS
estimator.note: World landmarks describe pose relative to mid-hip, not world travel or physically calibrated ring position/scale. World +Y points downward in image coordinates; smaller Z is closer to the camera. Presence may be null when the model does not provide it. Visibility is per-landmark confidence; the API does not expose a whole-person detection score. Hidden joints may be guessed.
